cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let Them Keep Hope
cards.instruction: Hide discouraging information because you believe hope is the only thing keeping someone able to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Let's pack your paintings for the last gallery. You've finally picked up a brush again. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If the big gallery rejected me too, I'm done. Did they write?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Their letter can wait. This gallery still needs your best three.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Pick them, then. I can't face another envelope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the envelopes. You finish the blue one; there's still somewhere for it to go.

mechanism: A directs the last gallery submission and takes over discouraged B tasks while hiding the rejection wording so B keeps painting.
confusable: Unlike generic optimism, A actively obscures discouraging information tied to B threat to stop; authority adapts the workload to keep B creating.
comparison: Professional rejection and delegated submission differ from shared gardening space and a concealed waiting-list position.
seedUse: D111-a paintings, last gallery and envelope avoidance; S02-a changes the work allocation to preserve participation.
